customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be a very good quality product that functions well and delivers great-tasting water. They appreciate its premium appearance, hassle-free installation, and maintenance-free operation for the first two years. The filter life receives mixed reviews, with some customers reporting malfunction within a month.

reviews.author: Rajdeep Paul
reviews.title: Good water purifier
reviews.body: very good product within this price range, smooth and clean installation process. Thanks Amazon ans UC ❤️

reviews.title: So far very good experience
reviews.body: So far so good. Previously tds was in hundreds, now it's com down to tens. 👍 Will update on warranty/repair process ( if any required) as we live in area with high tds water supply area.

reviews.author: Nikhil Shiv
reviews.title: Excellent Product and Service
reviews.body: Great product with excellent service. The water tastes much better, and the installation process was easy. Happy with my purchase and would recommend it.

reviews.author: Aishwarya Singh
reviews.title: A Good Product and A greater Service Experience
reviews.body: Using it for 3weeks no issue so far. installation process was seamless. I would recommend this water purifier for if nothing else then a great customer service experience like thats a novelty in india. also paying for a filter after 2 year is a huge plus and all consultation and maintenance service free for 2 years.
